support.quote: The plaice ( Pleuronectes platessa ) is a typical flatfish. It is oval in shape and is right-eyed (if the fish is visualised swimming upright, then both the eyes are on the right side of the body).
The upper side is basically brown with numerous, conspicuous orange or red spots. ... The lower side is white.
Smooth with small scales. Bony ridge behind the eyes. Upper side brown or greenish brown with irregularly distributed bright red or orange spots. The underside is white.
Bright orange or red spots on the upper side.
Smooth with small scales. Bony ridge behind the eyes. Upper side brown or greenish brown with irregularly distributed bright red or orange spots. The underside is white.
